verses.context: In a cluster of sayings about what pleases or grieves the Lord, Solomon turns to the question of who is near to God and who is far away.

verses.context: Just after a saying about a quarrelsome wife, Solomon contrasts what parents can pass down with a blessing only the Lord can give.

verses.context: Among sayings about kings, vows and honest weights, Solomon turns from what people show outwardly to what lies deep inside them.
